releases.title: Settings & Notes Order
notes: Every tab has its own settings (the gear next to the title) to choose when you get notified:
Alarms: turn the heads-up on or off and pick 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour or 2 hours before.
Timers: optional notification 1 or 5 minutes before a timer ends.
To-dos: notification at the deadline, plus an optional early reminder (5 min to 1 day before).
Notes: pin notes to the top, Move to Top, drag to rearrange, and sort by Manual, Date Edited, Date Created or Title.
Changing an alarm's time after it rang or was dismissed now lets it ring again at the new time the same day.
Lock screen alarm widgets show zzz when no alarm rings in the next 24 hours.
The next alarm now sits on the same line as the Alarms title. Timers, To-Do and Notes use the same title style, and Talk has no title.
Links the assistant sends in chat now appear as cards on the left, like attachments.
About & Updates moved into settings. This also fixes the info button flickering when switching tabs.
Deadline suggestions are easier to read, in two columns without repeating the day.

releases.title: Widgets Open What You Tap
notes: Tapping the Next Alarm widget now opens that alarm in the app.
Tapping a to-do in the Up Next widget opens it on the To-Do tab. Tapping its circle still checks it off. Alarms and timers open their tabs too.
New quick times for to-do deadlines: Morning, Noon, Afternoon, Evening and Night. They keep the day you picked, and move to tomorrow if that time has already passed.

releases.title: Notes & Smarter Widget
notes: New Notes tab. Every note has a Copy All button, and you can ask the assistant about your notes or have it write to them.
The To-Do widget is now Up Next. It shows what matters right now: an alarm you can dismiss, running timers and to-dos that are due.
Tap the ✦ button in the corner of the Up Next widget to ask the assistant from your home screen.
Tap a change in the chat (like "Alarm updated") to jump straight to that alarm, to-do or note.
Asking the assistant to change an alarm's days now works reliably, including "weekdays", "mon-fri" and "every day except Sunday".
You now get the 1-hour heads-up even when you set an alarm less than an hour before it rings.
To-dos can have an extra line of detail. Mark as Done is now a button next to Delete.
Alarm times and deadlines are picked in 5-minute steps.
New Alarm, New To-Do and New Note are big buttons at the bottom, easy to reach with your thumb.
Tidier layouts: timer presets and deadline suggestions no longer scroll sideways, the timer wheel labels are evenly spaced, and widget text lines up with its checkboxes.

releases.title: Updates & Patch Notes
notes: The app now checks for new versions and lets you know when an update is ready.
See what changed in every version: tap the info button on the Alarms tab.
A short "What's New" summary appears the first time you open a new version.

releases.title: Control Center
notes: New Ask Assistant control: type or dictate a request from Control Center and get the reply without opening the app.
New Live Talk control: jump straight into hands-free talking.
Ask the assistant through Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts or the Action button.

releases.title: To-Dos & Widgets
notes: New To-Do tab with suggested deadlines like "Tonight" or "Tomorrow morning", plus custom times.
Get a notification at each deadline, with Mark as Done and Remind Me in 1 Hour buttons.
New To-Do widget for the home and lock screen: check items off without opening the app.
The Next Alarm widget now comes in a home screen size.
The assistant can now create, change and delete alarms and to-dos, and change your settings.

releases.title: Timers & Talk
notes: New Timers tab. Timers ring even in Silent mode and count down on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island.
New Talk tab: a private assistant that runs on your iPhone. Chat by text, or talk hands-free with Live Talk.
Optional wake word, so Live Talk only answers when you start with it.
The assistant can start, list and cancel timers.

releases.title: Smarter Dismiss
notes: Dismissing the next ring of a repeating alarm is more reliable and no longer needs you to open the app afterwards.

releases.title: First Release
notes: Alarms for any days of the week that ring like the built-in Clock app, even in Silent mode.
Lock screen widget showing when your next alarm goes off.
A heads-up notification 1 hour before each alarm, with a button to dismiss that ring.
Open the app within the hour to dismiss it from there too.
